description: Shareable Meal Cards - After food scan confirmation, generate a beautiful Instagram-story-sized card (1080x1920) showing food photo, nutrition breakdown, health score, and RepGate branding. User can share to Instagram Stories, WhatsApp Status, or save to gallery.
steps: Add `share_plus: ^7.2.1` and `screenshot: ^2.1.0` to pubspec.yaml under dependencies, with a comment explaining their purpose (shareable card generation and social sharing). These are the minimal additions needed.

Create lib/widgets/meal_share_card.dart - A StatelessWidget that renders the shareable card at 1080x1920 using a Column layout inside a Container with RepGate branding. Include: (1) Food photo at top (from imageUrl or localImagePath), (2) Gradient overlay with food name, (3) Macro breakdown row (reuse the MacroRow pattern from macro_widgets.dart but styled for dark card background), (4) Health score bar (reuse HealthScoreBar pattern), (5) Total calories prominently displayed, (6) RepGate logo/branding at bottom with 'Track your nutrition with RepGate' tagline. Use AppColors (lime, ink, white) for branding consistency.

Create lib/services/share_service.dart - A service class with methods: (1) `captureCardAsImage(GlobalKey key)` - uses Screenshot package to capture the meal card widget as a Uint8List PNG, (2) `shareToSocial(Uint8List imageBytes, String caption)` - uses share_plus to share the image with text to any app (Instagram, WhatsApp, etc.), (3) `saveToGallery(Uint8List imageBytes)` - saves the PNG to device gallery. Import path_provider is NOT needed since screenshot package handles temp file creation internally.

Create lib/screens/food/meal_card_preview_screen.dart - A full-screen preview showing the rendered meal card with action buttons at the bottom: 'Share' (opens native share sheet via share_plus), 'Save to Gallery'. The card is wrapped in a RepaintBoundary with a GlobalKey for screenshot capture. Show a loading indicator while the image is being generated.

Modify lib/screens/food/food_details_screen.dart - After successful save in the _save() method (after 'Added to your log' snackbar), navigate to MealCardPreviewScreen passing the confirmed items, mealType, imageUrl, localImagePath, calories, protein, carbs, fat, and health score. Add a 'Share' icon button in the sticky bottom action bar (next to 'Add Food') that also navigates to the card preview.
Ensure the meal card widget handles both network images (imageUrl) and local file images (localImagePath) gracefully, with a placeholder gradient if neither is available.
acceptance_criteria: share_plus and screenshot packages are added to pubspec.yaml with explanatory comments
MealShareCard widget renders a 1080x1920 card with food photo, macros, health score, calories, and RepGate branding
ShareService has captureCardAsImage, shareToSocial, and saveToGallery methods
MealCardPreviewScreen shows the card preview with Share and Save buttons
After confirming food log in FoodDetailsScreen, user is offered to share the meal card
All new Dart files import correctly and follow existing code patterns (AppColors, AppTheme, etc.)
verification: Run `dart analyze lib/widgets/meal_share_card.dart lib/services/share_service.dart lib/screens/food/meal_card_preview_screen.dart` if dart CLI is available, otherwise verify imports and syntax manually
Verify food_details_screen.dart still has valid Dart syntax after modifications
Check that pubspec.yaml is valid YAML with proper indentation
